output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[]
    for row in grid:
        # locate the separator 2, then combine equal-width sides
        k=row.index(2)
        left=row[:k]
        right=row[k+1:]
        out.append([1 if left[i]==7 or right[i]==7 else 0 for i in range(min(len(left),len(right)))])
    return out"}
